svg.text: SAEE v1.2 Synthetic Parasitic Phase Transition
Bounded Phi, entropy, and dominance across A/B/C governance regimes; local synthetic DBI evidence only.
Figure: A enters the parasitic phase rapidly, B delays transition, and C remains below Phi_c in the current closure run.
Transition markers show first detected Phi crossing; statistical support is reported separately in statistical_summary.json.
